protocol.proxy: OHLC4; WilderRSI14; HLC3-MFI14; BB25 SMA/populationSTD multiplier2; OHLC4 Stochastic21 SMA3; mountain=(RSI+MFI+BollOsc+Stoch/3)/2; MA=EMA15.
protocol.seed: Wilder SMA of14 valid changes; EMA starts at first finite value; undefined ratios=>NaN.
protocol.geometry: inside: min(0,mountain)<MA<max(0,mountain). Boundary equality is outside. ENTRY outside->inside, EXIT inside->outside; first valid state/gap recovery is context only.
protocol.reentry: ENTRY with prior EXIT in same continuous valid segment, age1..configuredTFbars. REENTRY is an ENTRY subset, not independent extra observations. All1/2/3/5 reported.
protocol.distance_to_zero: abs(MA), continuous indicator units; also abs(mountain). No entry threshold.
protocol.separation: abs(mountain-MA) while inside; relevant edge=outer mountain, not PVI/NVI. Strength compares consecutive inside bars only; first inside=NEW_INSIDE.

complementary.adx: Wilder ADX14 / DI14; rising diagnostic, no absolute entry threshold
complementary.bbwp: CLOSE SMA7 populationSTD width; rank strictly lower against PRIOR100 finite widths. EXPANDING/CONTRACTING/STABLE are slope labels, no fitted compression zones
complementary.trend_speed: NOT IMPLEMENTED / FORMULA NOT VERIFIED;117/2.7/150/100/From start metadata only

protocol.direction: LONG is descriptive positive mountain+inside+DI+>DI-, not entry permission; AO/ADX/BBWP are reasons/context, NOT mandatory filters. SETUP_FORMING: positive inside withoutDIalignment, or positive rising mountain outside. Negative mountain with bearishDI/AO => BLOCKED/SHORT_LOGIC_NOT_PROVEN; otherwise WAIT. Missing evidence => BLOCKED. No score, no SHORT inversion.
protocol.outcomes: Gross price observations at reference closedTFclose; future COMPLETE1H candles only. No assumed fill, costs, funding, sizing, account profit or executable strategy. Forward returns/MFE/MAE always raw BTC orientation, including EXIT.
protocol.first_passage: Independent+1/-1/+2/-2 hit times and symmetric1/1,2/2 race; same1Hbar=>AMBIGUOUS, unresolved=>UNRESOLVED. Not invented intrabar ordering.
protocol.cohorts: TRAIN tertiles fixed perTF for continuous distance/separation; no profitable cutoff search. ADX favorable=slope>0; DI/AO aligned for LONG interpretation, EXIT bearish diagnostic only. BBWP expanding=slope>0. Cohorts not gates; overlapping observations not independent.
protocol.control: Deterministic non-event controls sameUTCmonth/hour, same trailing24TFbar trend sign; exclude all technical events, no return-based matching; missing exact match excluded explicitly.
protocol.inference: Primary endpoint24h event-minus-control return,7day block bootstrap500 seed9821. ENTRY positive / EXIT negative are descriptive hypotheses, not SHORT trades. No multiple-testing significance claim for secondary tables.
protocol.classification: USEFUL OBSERVER only if >=2TF have ENTRY/EXIT n>=100 matched24h, both directional CI95 lower>0 and positive directional excess in2024/2025/2026. NO EDGE if neither1H nor4H has both primary signs favorable with adequate samples; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. No live promotion classification.
